name: cc-hud
description: A usage panel under the prompt (model, project, context, 5-hour and weekly quota with pace warnings) with a settings toolbar, English/Chinese UI and one-click handoff prompts with a handoff history and clear & continue; a subagent board showing what each subagent and workflow agent is doing; plus a moody pixel crab above the prompt that acts out each tool and walks with your subagents (terminal; Windows / macOS / Linux)
